g.text: Upper: absolute RMSE +/- 1 MCSE. Lower: relative improvement over the shared DM baseline.
Independent zoomed y scales across cohorts; compare numeric values, not panel heights. This is not a budget curve.
Sodium: lower RMSE in 6/10 model-cohort comparisons. Largest reduction: DeepSeek, gender, 7.36%.
Top error bars: +/- 1 finite-B Monte Carlo SE (delta method), not patient-sampling SE or confidence intervals; full ranges shown.
Bottom: 100 x (DM - DM+) / DM from saved RMSE; no percentage confidence intervals or error bars are implied.
500 requested CF annotations; 500 paired draws per estimable cell. Reference: observed reward mean proxy, not causal ground truth.
